images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE landscape rough concept art sheet for Duck Rails, a cooperative VR horror-comedy featuring small expressive cartoon ducks using gorilla-style hand movement. This is an EARLY 2D DESIGN SKETCH, emphatically not a 3D render, polished illustration, production model or screenshot. Loose graphite construction lines, rough ink contours, broad flat gouache/marker washes, visible unfinished edges on warm ivory sketch paper; appealing chunky industrial shape design. Sheet title only: 'DUCK RAILS / TRAIN STUDY'. Main large three-quarter sketch occupying upper two thirds: a compact modern industrial utility train with a very spacious mostly OPEN AIR crew deck for eight small ducks and loose equipment, open above and along sides, no roof over passenger area, generous unobstructed entrances with simple thin low rails. A SMALL lightly enclosed front driving shelter only, weathered teal painted metal and ivory trim, amber grips and modest warm practical lights, dull rubber and metal, an integrated small coal furnace at the front with a warm open mouth, accessible radio and hook-mounted full-size bags along an edge. Functional simple machinery, broad wear patches, not ornate steampunk or Old West locomotive. Critical geometry: duck player's typical EYE LINE is just 0.5 metres ABOVE THE DECK, not human standing height. Front windshield/open windows extend almost to floor, sills visibly below this eye line, modest low front bodywork; keep forward sight toward rails clear. Driver controls low and off to the side of the view, NO tall dashboard or long tall hood. Include tiny simplified low duck silhouettes with expressive beaks for scale, NOT final character designs; no human driver. Bottom two inset exploratory sketches: (left) actual driver's POV from 0.5 m above deck through the very low front window showing clear rails ahead, (right) a simple side section with deck baseline, a crouched low duck eye point, a dashed horizontal eye line visibly above the window sill, and exact legible label '0.5 m eye line'. Main train body should feel long and wide enough for a group, not a tiny one-person cart. Mostly muted teal #287477, weathered bluegray #485B63, ivory #E8DDC0 and selective amber #E9AE45 on warm neutral paper. Sparse annotations 'OPEN CREW DECK' and 'LOW FRONT WINDOWS'. Rough speculative concept, readable silhouette and layout, no technical dimensional promises beyond the eye reference, no extra poster text, no logos or watermark.

A small uncertain zombie-duck silhouette deep in the depot suggests danger; enemies are on the ground only, not aboard. No western theme, no elaborate steampunk, no mountains of rubble, no combat spectacle, no gore, no UI, no topology diagrams. Show the exploration invitation and return landmark in a single cohesive rough scene.
